title: A tidy removal renews its clean/<KEY> claim while it runs
goal: tidy --apply renews the coord claim clean/<KEY> of a removal that runs longer than half of bl_clean.CLAIM_TTL, so a slow removal is never claimed by a second session mid-way

run:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bl_clean, inspect
if "renew" not in inspect.getsource(bl_clean):
    print("check failed: no removal claim is renewed"); sys.exit(1)

notes: SP-ep7cyuob review (S3): CLAIM_TTL is 600 s with no renewal; a removal slower than that could be claimed again mid-way (unlikely); a crash between claim and removal blocks others up to 600 s. The check reads source because a removal slower than the ttl cannot be planted in a short run; the item should replace it with a planted run that sets a short ttl.
